entry.title: TradingView Partners with HTX to Enhance Crypto Market Access for Traders
entry.summary:
HTX, a cryptocurrency trading platform, has integrated with TradingView. This addition introduces new cryptocurrency pairs, enabling users to monitor and trade a wider range of assets directly through TradingView. HTX Expands Offerings via TradingView The integration with TradingView allows users to access HTX’s offerings directly from the TradingView interface. By logging in with their credentials, users can access HTX’s trading panel to implement cryptocurrency trading strategies without leaving TradingView. The platform claims over 47 million users globally and records a daily trading volume exceeding $2 billion. HTX offers more than 700 trading pairs, spanning both spot and derivatives markets. Fees start at 0.01%, with discounts available to users enabling $HTX deductions, aimed at benefiting traders with varied experience levels. Meanwhile, tastyFX, a forex broker in the United States, has integrated with TradingView, allowing users with a tastyFX account to trade directly on the platform, as reported by Finance Magantes. This partnership provides tastyFX customers with enhanced features, including standard industry charts, advanced technical analysis tools, and market notifications. Users will also access a comprehensive analytical suite, a strategy tester, and the Pine Script language for custom indicators. Established in 2013, HTX, previously known as Huobi, operates as an international platform for digital assets trading. The exchange holds licenses across various key cryptocurrency regions, including Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East. It provides services such as buying, selling, staking, and borrowing cryptocurrencies, catering to virtual asset enthusiasts.
This article was written by Tareq Sikder at www.financemagnates.com.
